title: vip template manifest (.vip.yaml)
description: Schema for the optional .vip.yaml (or .vip.yml) manifest read by 'vip' when scaffolding a project. See docs/templates.md for the full reference. This schema covers structural shape only -- some rules enforced by 'vip' (e.g. no duplicate key across options/variables, select options need >=1 choice) can't be expressed here and are validated at runtime instead.

schema.description: Manifest format version. vip currently supports 1 (legacy, no metadata.language/type) and 2 (current); anything higher is rejected at runtime, matching this schema's maximum. Manifests without this field are treated as schema 1.

options.description: User-selectable boolean/choice options, exposed to templates as .Features.<key>.

variables.description: Free-form input fields, exposed to templates as .Features.<key>.

name.description: Display name shown by 'vip template inspect'.

description.description: One-line description shown by 'vip template inspect'.

language.description: Programming language (e.g. go, node). Used by 'vip template add' to register the template under templates.<language>.<type> without needing --language.

type.description: Project type (e.g. service, lambda, worker). Used alongside language by 'vip template add'.

key.description: Unique key, exposed to templates as .Features.<key>. Must not be reused by another option or variable.

prompt.description: Prompt shown to the user when this option is resolved interactively.

default.description: Default value. Should be a boolean for bool/boolean options, or a string choice value for select options.

choices.description: Required for type: select. Must contain at least one choice.

label.description: Display label shown to the user. Defaults to value if omitted.

key.description: Unique key, exposed to templates as .Features.<key>. Must not be reused by another option or variable.

type.description: Free-form input type hint (e.g. string, kebab-case). Not restricted by vip.

prompt.description: Prompt shown to the user when this variable is resolved interactively.

pattern.description: Regular expression the resolved value must match. Must compile as a valid Go regexp.

message.description: Error message shown when the value fails to match pattern.

path.description: File or directory path (glob supported) relative to the template root.

when.description: Expression gating this rule, e.g. "sns", "sqs && !dynamo". Supports &&, ||, !, ==, !=, and bare truthy option/variable lookups.

hooks.description: Reserved for future use. Not currently executed by vip during scaffolding -- declaring hooks here has no effect. For working post-scaffold automation, define a post-install hook in your CLI config (templates.<language>.<type>.hooks) instead; see docs/configuration.md.

hook.description: Reserved for future use; not currently executed by vip. See the 'hooks' description above.

name.description: Display name shown when the hook runs.

when.description: Expression gating whether this hook runs, e.g. "sns", "sqs && !dynamo".
